# Impeccable detector resource

Use the pinned scripts/impeccable launcher for scoped deterministic detection
through frontend-design/references/review.md. Keep the caller's cwd at the repo.
The launcher, scripts/VERSION, data, LICENSE, and NOTICE.md retain provenance.
A missing binary may require a download; offline use is not assumed.

UPSTREAM.md and reference/ retain historical/specialist upstream knowledge.
They are not project entrypoints. Do not load consultation, persona, interview,
or multi-agent workflows during ordinary implementation QA. Explicit stylistic
work follows the actual request and project design decisions. Re-vendoring
must preserve this resource-only integration.
